scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @vichaar/shared && npm run build -w @vichaar/validation && npm run build -w @vichaar/database && npm run build -w @vichaar/agents
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @vichaar/web" "npm run dev -w @vichaar/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vichaar/api && npm run build -w @vichaar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/postgres/tsconfig.ai.json
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:db-safety
scripts.test-db:verify: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-db.mjs verify
scripts.test-db:safety: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vichaar/api && node scripts/test-db.mjs safety
scripts.test-db:ai: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @vichaar/api && node scripts/test-db.mjs ai
